description: Na₃Ag(TeS₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-23°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.91-2.97 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-11°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.92-3.07 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-23°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.86-3.35 Å. Ag is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Ag-S bond distances ranging from 2.63-2.74 Å. There are two inequivalent Te sites. In the first Te site, Te is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three S atoms. There are a spread of Te-S bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.40 Å. In the second Te site, Te is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three S atoms. There are a spread of Te-S bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.40 Å. There are six inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four Na and one Te atom to form SNa₄Te square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SNa₄AgTe octahedra, corners with two equivalent SNa₄Te square pyramids, corners with three equivalent SNa₂AgTe trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent SNa₄AgTe octahedra, and edges with three equivalent SNa₄Te square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 11°. In the second S site, S is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ag, and one Te atom. In the third S site, S is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ag, and one Te atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded to two Na, one Ag, and one Te atom to form distorted SNa₂AgTe trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SNa₄AgTe octahedra, corners with five SNa₄Te square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent SNa₄AgTe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 86°. In the fifth S site, S is bonded to four Na and one Te atom to form SNa₄Te square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SNa₄AgTe octahedra, corners with two equivalent SNa₄Te square pyramids, corners with two equivalent SNa₂AgTe trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent SNa₄AgTe octahedra, and edges with three equivalent SNa₄Te square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. In the sixth S site, S is bonded to four Na, one Ag, and one Te atom to form distorted SNa₄AgTe octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SNa₄AgTe octahedra, corners with two SNa₄Te square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one SNa₂AgTe trigonal pyramid, edges with four SNa₄Te square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent SNa₂AgTe trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 8°.
